messages:
leah: Noticing an uptick in routed fallbacks to v2 for several tenants after the new deprecation banner rollout. Console shows compat.decay spiking. Anyone else seeing header entropy causing this?
ben: Yep, saw it around 01:12 UTC. A lot of clients set x-client-version=v1 but omit x-legacy-features, so our compatibility scoring treats them as unknown -> fallback.
nana: Config we pushed: 
```
routing:
  deprecation_mode: staged
  fallback_threshold: 0.92
  compat_decay_seconds: 60
  tenant_overrides: {}
```
michael: We added compat_decay_seconds to avoid small blips causing immediate fallbacks, but telemetry suggests the decay period interacts poorly with our tenant sampling. High QPS tenants still flip.
leah: Proposal: (1) add "tenant_cohort" sampling so we only apply strict fallback to 10% beta cohort, (2) surface an estimated fallback impact preview on the rollout page before commit, (3) queue deprecation banners instead of immediate banner for contract-aware tenants.
ben: For (1) we can add rollout cohorts: `cohort: {percent: 10, seed: sha256(tenant-id)}`. For (2) need a preview endpoint that simulates routing across recent metric window. I can add `/api/rollouts/preview` returning simulated fallback_rate and quota_impact.
nana: UX note: ops asked for a "what-if" showing quota consumption delta if the tenant is forced to v2. They want both token-cost delta and expected latency p95.
michael: Telemetry change: add a tag `telemetry.compat_example=true` to simulated traces so we don't mix preview traces with production. Also emit `compat.preview_ratio` in the preview response.
leah: Immediate mitigation: create a console toggle to disable automatic enforcement for contract-tier tenants. We should also add a throttled notice that only shows in console (not banner) and queue the actual customer-facing banner to be sent with delay and human review.
ops-bot: deploy log: "rollout-service v1.9.0 -> added rollout preview API" at 01:05 UTC.
ben: I'll implement cohort sampling + preview endpoint. ETA: 4hrs. Will include unit tests that run simulation against last 5m of headers.
michael: I'll add telemetry flags and ensure preview traces don't affect alerting. Also will copy the quota delta metric to `preview.quota_delta` so Billing can triage.
nana: UX: I'll add a preview card on the rollout page with two toggles: "apply cohort" and "queue banner". Tooltip copy: "Preview estimates how many requests would be routed to the new version and the expected token-cost delta."
leah: Great. After preview is live let's run a dry-run on a small tenant cohort and check `compat.fallback_rate`, `latency.p95`, and `billing.preview_quota_delta` for 1 hour. If stable, we widen cohort.
ops-bot: noted. Scheduling dry-run for cohort 10% starting 03:00 UTC.
leah: Thanks team. Follow-ups: ben -> cohort + preview; michael -> telemetry tags + preview metrics; nana -> rollout UX card and copy; I'll coordinate dry-run and update incident channel if anything pops.
ben: copying design doc link: https://docs.redwood.internal/rollouts/cohort-preview
michael: :thumbsup:
